The '''Paladins of the Adamite Tower''' was a [[The Force/Legends|Force]] tradition of warrior judges among the people of [[Weik/Legends|Weik]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] deep in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] that was long disconnected from the [[The galaxy/Legends|civilized galaxy]].

==History==
A [[Starship/Legends|starship]] crashed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Weik/Legends|Weik]] among the [[Ordan Spine Mountains]]. The so-called [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the ship, [[Vasque Mirlan]], led white armored soldiers towards [[Vossport/Legends|Vossport]] burning down villages throughout the [[Karnik Valley]]. With more advanced weaponry, Mirlan's warriors defeated the local army until four [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-wielders]] with [[Lightsaber/Legends|sunfire swords]], ancient lightsabers of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] that crashed on Weik thousands of years prior, engaged them in battle. When Mirlan was killed in battle, his soldiers fled into the hills.<ref name="NoP" />

The four champions returned to Vossport where they refused all rewards and titles, instead asking for stewardship of the strange tower left visible in the mountains of the Ordan Spine. Taking up residence within the so-called [[Adamite Tower]], the four Force-sensitives took up residence in the area, founding a feudal society and serving justice to those who sought to corrupt or disturb life. The Paladins were recognized as warrior-judges, feared for their strength but respected for their righteousness.

Supplicants seeking to join the ranks of the Paladins took vows to forsake their former lives, donning helmets that they covered with their hoods. New members were given a sunfire sword, which was used to create a [[Adamite Signet Ring]] by cutting a [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] fitting from the remains of the starship and base of the Paladins, Adamite Tower, and carving the crest of the Tower into the ring. When abroad, the Paladins wore reforged armor to protect from the simple bullets of the scoundrels of Weik. Fighting with bows and a quiver of arrows, as well as sunfire swords.<ref name="NoP" />
